fixture_seed: fixed sequential IDs; frozen worker normalization time=Unix(200000)

full_test.command: TMPDIR=<task> GOMAXPROCS=2 mise exec -- go test -p 2 ./... -timeout 30m

targeted_race.command: TMPDIR=<task> GOMAXPROCS=2 mise exec -- go test -timeout 60m -race -p 2 ./internal/context ./internal/team ./cmd/hufu -run 'Test(SearchLineage|HybridLineage|AllowedItemIDs|LineageConstraint|WorkerMemoryPassesAncestor|WorkerMemoryRecallsAncestor|SemanticIndexAllowed|Supplemental|RepositoryQueryIDs|WP6|CLIInvocationsDoNotRetainHelp|ResumeCommandActivatesVersionedBranchBeforeProvider)' -count=1

validation.scope: working tree, preserving pre-existing unrelated edits; not an immutable new HEAD claim
